solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Blessed rip-off, second given an estimate

parts.note: a con is a swindle or rip-off
something rated has been assessed or given an estimate of its worth

explanation.surface: A sarcastic grumble about an overpriced holy relic that someone has just put a valuation on.
explanation.definitionFit: A church or altar that has been made holy in a ceremony is blessed.

clue.text: Not the usual bits of meat loaf mixed with fine stuffing

definitions.text: Not the usual bits of meat

indicators.note: stuffing means the letter for fine is packed inside the jumbled letters
mixed tells us the letters of loaf are jumbled into a new order

parts.note: F is the pencil-grade abbreviation for fine

explanation.surface: A recipe: a meatloaf with something fancy for the stuffing, made from offcuts rather than prime cuts.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mixed' turns LOAF into OFAL; 'stuffing' puts F inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Offal is the organs and entrails of an animal, cuts other than the usual muscle meat.

clue.text: Lead at this place went very fast, for Spooner

indicators.note: for Spooner means swap the opening sounds of the two words, as Reverend Spooner famously did

parts.note: here means at this place
sped means went very fast

explanation.surface: Someone in front sped off from this spot, told in a garbled way.
explanation.walkthrough: HERE SPED with initial sounds swapped becomes SPEAR HEAD, by sound rather than spelling.
explanation.definitionFit: To spearhead a campaign is to lead it from the front, a verb synonym.

clue.text: Burning fuel engulfs hot throttle

indicators.note: engulfs means the fuel word swallows up the letter for hot

parts.note: coke is a solid fuel burned in furnaces
H is the abbreviation for hot, as on taps

explanation.surface: A furnace fire flares up around something hot, perhaps an engine throttle.
explanation.definitionFit: To throttle someone is to strangle them, a synonym verb.

clue.text: Was Wren alternatively shown to inspire with wonder?

indicators.note: alternatively tells us to take every other letter of the words Was Wren

explanation.surface: A question about whether the architect Christopher Wren designed buildings to impress.
explanation.definitionFit: To awe someone is to fill them with wonder and reverence, a verb synonym.

clue.text: Printing space to handle petition?

parts.note: an en is a unit of space in typesetting and printing
to treat something is to handle or deal with it

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether a petition document needs printing space to be handled.
explanation.definitionFit: To petition someone is to beg or plead with them, the same as to entreat.

clue.text: Inadvisable way to learn to drive quickly?

definitions.text: Inadvisable way to learn to drive quickly?

parts.words: Inadvisable way to learn to drive quickly?
parts.note: an intensive short programme of study, read literally as a driving course that ends in collisions

explanation.walkthrough: Learning to drive by having accidents is inadvisable; the phrase also names a fast-track course of study.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom for an intensive short training programme, here taken literally as crashing a car.

clue.text: Choir paid as somehow promoting love

indicators.note: somehow says the letters of the three words are arranged in some new way

explanation.surface: A choir has been paid to sing something romantic.
explanation.definitionFit: An adjective for something that arouses sexual desire, named after the goddess of love.

clue.text: Search shooter

definitions.meaning: to rummage hastily through a drawer or bag

explanation.definitionFit: One word is both a verb for ransacking and a noun for a gun.

clue.text: Smallest possible staircase for a dance?

definitions.meaning: a flight with only a single tread
a quick ragtime-era ballroom dance in duple time

explanation.definitionFit: The name of a 1910s ballroom dance, also read literally as a staircase of just one tread.

clue.text: Most seductive attempts in misplaced lust

indicators.note: in means the attempts word goes inside the rearranged letters
misplaced means the letters of lust are put in the wrong order

parts.note: tries are attempts

explanation.surface: Someone's most seductive moves are attempts driven by lust aimed at the wrong person.
explanation.walkthrough: 'misplaced' rearranges the fodder to SULT, and 'in' places the attempts inside it, between L and T.
explanation.definitionFit: Sultry means passionate and alluring, so the superlative is the most seductive.

clue.text: Doctor and master plumber, say

indicators.note: to doctor something is to tamper with it, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A list of professionals: a doctor, a master and a plumber.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Doctor' looks like a profession in the list but is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: A plumber is an example of a skilled worker in a trade; 'say' marks the example.

clue.text: Go wrong or right, led by the Queen

indicators.note: led by means the right letter comes after the Queen's letters

parts.note: ER is Elizabeth Regina, the late Queen

explanation.surface: A royal remark on whether the Queen leads us to right or wrong.
explanation.definitionFit: To err is to make a mistake, a verb synonym.

clue.text: American general's broken truces

indicators.note: broken means the letters of truces are smashed and reassembled

explanation.surface: A US general's broken ceasefires, a fair summary of the Indian Wars.
explanation.definitionFit: George Armstrong Custer was the US cavalry general killed at Little Bighorn.

clue.text: Dawn and Susan eating near island

indicators.note: eating means the name for Susan takes the other letters inside it

parts.note: Sue is short for Susan

explanation.surface: Two women, Dawn and Susan, having a meal near an island.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dawn' poses as a woman's name beside Susan but is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Daybreak is when the sun comes up, so the two are synonyms.

clue.text: Lived with Heath, possibly very drunk?

parts.note: was means existed or lived
Ted Heath was a British Prime Minister; 'possibly' marks him as one example of a Ted

explanation.surface: A question whether someone who lived with Heath was always drunk.
explanation.walkthrough: Edward 'Ted' Heath was British Prime Minister 1970-74.
explanation.definitionFit: Slang for being heavily intoxicated, like smashed or hammered.

clue.text: Vase included in furnishings

indicators.note: included in means the letters sit inside the word furnishings

explanation.surface: A vase comes as part of the furnishings of a room.
explanation.definitionFit: An urn is a tall rounded vase, often with a foot.

clue.text: Shrinks and perhaps irons clothes?

definitions.meaning: takes the creases out of garments

explanation.definitionFit: A verb for reducing, punned as removing creases, which ironing does.

clue.text: Swear at dogs on top of Everest

parts.note: curs are mongrel dogs

indicators.note: top of means the first letter, the top in a down clue

explanation.surface: A climber swears at dogs on the summit of Everest.
explanation.definitionFit: To curse someone is to swear at them or damn them.

clue.text: French name is brought up for an apostle

indicators.note: brought up means the letters are read upwards, backwards in a down clue

parts.note: nom is French for name

explanation.surface: A French first name that turns out to be an apostle's.
explanation.definitionFit: Simon Peter and Simon the Zealot were both among the twelve apostles.

clue.text: Vocalist embraces wife, lively modern person

indicators.note: embraces means the vocalist word holds the letter for wife

parts.note: a singer is a vocalist

explanation.surface: A singer hugging his wife, who is a lively up-to-date type.
explanation.definitionFit: A dated slang term for a fashionable, fun-loving, uninhibited person.

clue.text: What's used to finish styling the kiss-curl?

definitions.text: What's used to finish styling the kiss-curl?

indicators.note: to finish means take the final letter of each of the next three words

explanation.surface: A hairdressing question about the product for setting a curl.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is the definition too: hair gel fixes a styled curl.
explanation.definitionFit: Hair gel is the product applied to set a curl in place when styling.

clue.text: Snake with advanced degrees in arts and business?

parts.note: MA is a Master of Arts, an advanced degree
MBA is a Master of Business Administration, the advanced degree in business

explanation.surface: A sneering question about a slippery character with an arts master's and an MBA.
explanation.definitionFit: The mamba is a fast, venomous African snake.

clue.text: Water supplier with average in gallons, having good intentions

parts.note: a well supplies water
the mean is an average

explanation.surface: A water company averaging out gallons and meaning well.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone well-intentioned means well even when things go wrong.
